scope: Fifteen lowercase print letters used by six family words. One continuous pen-down movement for body letters; i dot and t cross are deliberate lifts.

references.role: Directional letter-formation descriptions and continuous manuscript movement, authored by Marion McBride. Consulted as a process reference; site diagrams and downloads are not copied.
Consistent start, direction and finish, matching the child's school print style.

geometry: Independently authored SVG centreline geometry implementing the referenced print movement. Not a digitized recording or a facsimile of a named person's handwriting.
userDecision: User confirmed: follow the print-letter process being taught; no personal sample/video supplied.
ink: Display actual child pointer trace; template animation draws separate ink and does not earn progress.
validation: Chronological arc progress with forward direction at retraced stems, start/end corridor, continuity, reverse and excess-travel limits. Small motor variation permitted; not a handwriting diagnosis.
